questions.question_text: Convert $7.625\text{ hours}$ to hours, minutes, and seconds.

options.why: Treated the decimal digits 625 as 62 minutes and 5 seconds.
Treated $0.5$ of a minute as 50 seconds instead of 30 seconds.
Rounded $0.625$ to $0.75$ hours.

questions.solution_text:
$\text{Whole hours} = 7\text{ h}$
$0.625 \times 60 = 37.5\text{ min} \implies 37\text{ min}$
$0.5 \times 60 = 30\text{ s}$
$= 7\text{ h } 37\text{ min } 30\text{ s}$

questions.question_text: A night train is scheduled to depart at $21{:}14$ and arrive at $06{:}05$ the following morning. What are these departure and arrival times in 12-hour format?

options.why: Subtracted 10 instead of 12 from 21:14.
Inverted both am and pm designations.
Subtracted 13 instead of 12 from 21:14.

questions.solution_text:
$\text{Departure} = 21{:}14 - 12{:}00 = 9{:}14\text{ pm}$
$\text{Arrival} = 06{:}05 = 6{:}05\text{ am}$
Depart $9{:}14\text{ pm}$, Arrive $6{:}05\text{ am}$
